lead_raw_text:
The structure of Gd2Fe4Si4 (reduced formula Gd(FeSi)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Si each adopt tetrahedral coordination, with Fe surrounded by four Si neighbors and Si by four Fe neighbors, while Gd centers exhibit a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors (4 Fe, 4 Si, 4 Gd). Polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Fe and Si tetrahedra, and corner- and face-sharing between the 12-vertex Gd polyhedra and Fe or Si tetrahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
